agent_priors_used: General agent prior (not SPIDER evidence): locally rational continuation is a known path-dependence/local-optimum failure mode of autonomous research systems, so flagged lanes were re-derived from today's Codex before accepting the inherited direction.

General agent prior (not SPIDER evidence): a comparator already saturated at a correctness ceiling cannot identify a treatment effect, so dynamic-range certification must precede any benchmark that relies on a performance margin.

General agent prior (not SPIDER evidence): a detector whose null/negative controls cannot fire produces uninterpretable positives, so control sensitivity is a design-time prerequisite, not a post-hoc diagnostic.

General agent prior (not SPIDER evidence): small CPU-quantized local models have a low, prompt-sensitive capability floor on multi-step tool-use tasks; task-specification completeness can dominate raw parameter count.
General agent prior (not SPIDER evidence): volatile transport/observability fields (e.g. hop-by-hop headers) are hygiene defects that invalidate a fingerprint, not scientific findings.

General agent prior (not SPIDER evidence): an empty or degenerate sampling frame discovered at freeze is a design failure that should be caught before freeze rather than re-discovered as MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

allocation.comparative_reasoning: The parent handoff proposed escalating to the four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark or an asymmetric-discovery fallback, but the funded-execution rule forbids the expensive benchmark until all three readiness conditions hold, and condition (1) is currently unmet. Among the three critical-path lanes, Product owns the carrier, Runtime owns the task bank, and Intel owns the endpoint; keeping Product on the carrier avoids two lanes colliding on the same prerequisite. Reopening C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY or C-PRODUCT-ECON now would re-discover the same ceiling-comparator defect already recorded in EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440 rather than remove it.
allocation.question: Can the audited parameterized-inheritance capability be made DURABLE and PROMOTABLE in the shipping kernel path (src/spider) -- a pre-freeze arm-differentiation certificate showing that the SHIPPED kernel executes an inherited parameterized mechanism (known-positive: induction observation -> parameterized distillation -> resolve to EXECUTABLE with a correctly bound, non-null action -> execute against the fixture -> verify) AND refuses a known-negative binding (missing-parameter / out-of-support / wrong-intent) with a recorded reason and a null action, with unit tests, an accounting check that the inherited-path counters increment, and the kernel identity bound at freeze -- so that the carrier actually lands in main through the pinned Product promotion path without manually copying experiment code?
allocation.rationale: B1 (shipped treatment carrier) is the highest-leverage open blocker: main still exposes literal distill() at confidence 0.5 and no shipped distill_parameterized(), even though EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064 (audit PASS) demonstrated the parameterized distill->resolve->execute path live, causally attributable and honestly accounted outside the synthetic fixture. The in-flight PREFREEZE experiment EXP-PRODUCT-37999047472 targets exactly the durable, promotable carrier. This also directly supplies readiness condition (1) for the flagship benchmark: a shipped treatment that can demonstrate a pre-freeze executable inherited parameterized mechanism plus a known-negative refusal.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: All six scientific lanes hold an unfinished PREFREEZE experiment dispatched by the prior direction cycle, and each in-flight mandate is still aligned with the current effective Codex and with the audit's priority order. No lane is idle or stalled and no experiment is frozen awaiting completion, so liveness requires no PARK and no frozen transaction is at risk. The program's decisive missing proof remains the end-to-end causal chain observe -> parameterized mechanism -> executable binding in the SHIPPED treatment -> applicability/freshness decision -> real external-agent action -> lower end-to-end cost per successful partially novel task. That chain is gated on three named blockers, and the three lanes on the critical path are physically working them: Product on B1 (audited parameterized carrier durable/promotable in the shipped kernel), Runtime on B2 (a credential-free task bank with certified pre-freeze dynamic range and a real treatment/comparator distinction), and Intel on B3 (settle or explicitly close the credential-free capable-model question). Graph is closing the last scope bound on C-FRESHNESS's value-blind guard (B5), Physics has pivoted off the rejected value-persistence subhypothesis to the materially new access-barrier observable, and Frontier is re-testing the path-persistence premise under design-contract v2 after its v1 freeze committed an empty DEEP sampling frame. Per the funded-execution rule, no lane is being authorized to run the full expensive C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY / C-PRODUCT-ECON benchmark until Product, Runtime and Intel clear their readiness conditions; all three are assigned blocker removal, not the benchmark. I therefore CONTINUE every in-flight pre-freeze mandate and change no scientific objective, using the strong preference in POLICY/architecture for continuing an unfinished PREFREEZE transaction whose mandate remains correct over churning it. Two lanes (graph, runtime, physics flagged by the snapshot's tunnel indicator) received an explicit cognitive reset; frontier's empirical concentration on C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY was also checked and still wins on merits because the site-native-discovery question falsifies a core SPIDER premise rather than refining it.
